work.text: he showed in that work (using therein great diligence, so as to rise equal to the esteem which had already been conceived of him) better inventions and a beautiful method in the attitude of a Madonna, whom he made with the Child in her arms and with many angels round her in adoration, on a gold ground
work.lead: Vasari on the panel for the monks of Vallombrosa:

source.author: Giorgio Vasari
source.title: Life of Giovanni Cimabue, in Lives of the Most Eminent Painters, Sculptors and Architects (trans. Gaston du C. de Vere)

work.text: The painting demonstrates the mature style of Cimabue, in which the artist overcomes the more rigid Byzantine styles with forms that are more loose and humanistic.

moment.text: The altarpiece of the Academy of Arts may rank high as regards composition and the study of nature; but the old types are too obstinately maintained in it

source.author: J. A. Crowe and G. B. Cavalcaselle
source.title: A History of Painting in Italy, vol. 1 (ed. Langton Douglas)

moment.text: Despite these improvements, there is a certain resistance to the stylistic innovations and techniques of Duccio and Giotto.

matters.text: to his heads of prophets, patriarchs, and apostles, whether introduced into his great pictures of the Madonna or in other sacred subjects, he gave a certain grandeur of expression and largeness of form
Below, at the sides of the throne, Jeremiah and Isaiah gaze up towards the child as if to confirm the prophecies written in their documents on the miraculous virgin birth of Jesus.
But a wild energy characterises the two prophets in the central niche.

source.author: J. A. Crowe and G. B. Cavalcaselle
source.title: A History of Painting in Italy, vol. 1 (ed. Langton Douglas)
